title: Free Wheelin
meta_description: Free Wheelin is a stylish 3BR Seacrest retreat with beach access, resort-style pool, bikes, and all the comforts of home---perfect for families.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Come coast your way around 30A! Free Wheelin is the perfect spot for your family getaway. This home has all new furnishings, brand new interior paint, lighting, and more! Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, Free Wheelin offers 1 King bedroom with its own ensuite, a bunk room with 1 full and 2 twins with an adjoining bathroom, and a spacious King Master suite at the end of the hall! Right when you walk in, you will be blown away by the spacious and beautifully decorated living area. This home is one level, so it is perfect for multiple generations!

ABOUT THE AREA: Seacrest Beach is one of the most charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private deeded beach! Also, a couple blocks away sits the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water.

AMENITY ACCESS: In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas.

\*\*\* Attention Guests, please note that there is an additional fee of $2 per day per guest staying at this property in Seacrest Beach. We are required by the Seacrest Beach HOA to collect this fee in order for you to stay in this community and use their amenities. We will collect this fee prior to your arrival.

BEACH ACCESS: Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies.

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 8
• Bedroom 1 -- King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- King, ensuite
• Bunk room -- Twin over twin \& 1 full, adjoining bathroom

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Gas Grill -- Propane
• Garage
• 2 bikes included
• Washer/Dryer
• Self-Check in
• Community Pool 12,000 sq ft. (unheated)
• Single level home
• Smart TVs in every bedroom
• Coffee Maker
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- PETS CONSIDERED (subject to approval and $250/dog)

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces. Seacrest Beach also has parallel parking spots throughout the community.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
